orcus.name: ORCUS EXO-X/O

traits.name: Temperature Regulator
traits.description: Protects the user from extreme temperatures by increasing or reducing the internal temperature of the suit by 30 degrees Celsius.

traits.name: Onboard Computer
traits.description: An onboard computer that allowed information trading amongst the battlefield at high speeds. Allows for Smart and Dumb AI to be stored and have access to the Armor’s systems. Allows the AI to boost the ORCUS Mythic Agility by +2 for three Rounds. This feature has a Recharge of 7 minutes.

traits.name: Liquid Nanocrystals
traits.description: Offers protection from attacks that lower armor or attack unarmored locations. Any Attacks that reduce Armor or attack unarmored locations count as having 17 Armor.

traits.name: Vacuum Regulator and Oxygen Recycler
traits.description: Allows the user to be in a vacuum and without oxygen for extended periods of time and is able to recycle oxygen as the user breathes. Has enough Oxygen to last 120 Minutes.

traits.name: Heads-up Display
traits.description: Allows the users to see important battle statistics and information on the allies and enemies nearby. Includes the Motion Tracker.

traits.name: VISR
traits.description: Equips the Character with VISR and Motion Tracker. Able to communicate with UEG, CAA, and UNSC infrastructures and communication options.

traits.name: Biofoam Injector Port
traits.description: The suit allows for the insertion of Biofoam using Biofoam Injection Modules. These Modules are ports in the armor that a Biofoam canister can attach to so the Character may apply Biofoam. Biofoam Auto-InjectorThe suit will automatically apply Biofoam as a Free Action. Has 5 uses and counts as having an Intellect Modifier of 5 for application. Each Biofoam use can be recharged with a Biofoam canister as a Full Action.

traits.name: EVA System
traits.description: Thrusters that allow the User to control their movements in zero gravity. Allows the User to turn 360 degrees in zero gravity in a Full Action. This removes any basic Penalties given from zero gravity scenarios. Has a Full Move speed of 12 Meters. Has Magnetized Boots for improved movement and the capability of walking on metallic surfaces.

traits.name: Improved Motion Tracker
traits.description: An upgraded Motion Tracker that doubles the distance of the Radar. Includes a Thermal Sensor for Thermal Imaging Special Rule, giving a +20 Bonus to Opposed Tests involving an Opponent’s Camouflage.

traits.name: Nano Technology
traits.description: When the suit is damaged, the suit will automatically begin a repair process. The suit will heal 1 point of damage against it or the user, once per day. The suit can do this 10 times before needing recharged between missions.

traits.name: Reactive Metal Liquid Crystals
traits.description: This offers the Spartans the Strength and Agility multipliers given by the suit. Reduces 30D10 from the amount of Falling Damage Roll the Character will take. If a Character were to take 25D10 Falling Damage, then no Damage would be rolled.

traits.name: ODST and Spartans Only
traits.description: This Armor is only allowed to be used by both ODST and Spartans during 2559 and later.

orcus.description: ORCUS Exoskeleton Semi-Powered Shock Trooper Armor.

traits.name: Battery Powered
traits.description: Mark 1, 2, and 3 Prototypes are battery-operated. There is a 500 cR, 80 kg Broadcast Power Generator that is able to generate power designed for these Prototypes that can recharge the batteries within a 20 meter radius as a Full Action. The Mark 1 Prototype, however, must be directly plugged into the Broadcast Power Generator. The Mark 3 Prototype doubles the radius it can draw power from the Broadcast Power Generator. The Batteries used for these Prototypes weigh 20 kg and cost 15 cR to replace or purchase new versions.

traits.description: Offers protection from attacks that lower armor or attack unarmored locations. Any Attacks that reduce Armor or attack unarmored locations count as having 18 Armor.

traits.name: Vacuum Regulator and Oxygen Recycler
traits.description: Allows the user to be in a vacuum and without oxygen for extended periods of time and is able to recycle oxygen as the user breathes. Has enough Oxygen to last 120 Minutes.

traits.name: Reactive Metal Liquid Crystals
traits.description: This offers the Spartans the Strength and Agility multipliers given by the suit. Reduces 30D10 from the amount of Falling Damage Roll the Character will take. If a Character were to take 25D10 Falling Damage, then no Damage would be rolled.

traits.name: Heads-up Display
traits.description: Allows the users to see important battle statistics and information on the allies and enemies nearby. Includes the Motion Tracker.

traits.name: VISR
traits.description: Equips the Character with VISR and Motion Tracker. Able to communicate with UEG, CAA, and UNSC infrastructures and communication options.

traits.name: Biofoam Injector Port
traits.description: The suit allows for the insertion of Biofoam using Biofoam Injection Modules. These Modules are ports in the armor that a Biofoam canister can attach to so the Character may apply Biofoam. Biofoam Auto-InjectorThe suit will automatically apply Biofoam as a Free Action. Has 5 uses and counts as having an Intellect Modifier of 5 for application. Each Biofoam use can be recharged with a Biofoam canister as a Full Action.

traits.name: EVA System
traits.description: Thrusters that allow the User to control their movements in zero gravity. Allows the User to turn 360 degrees in zero gravity in a Full Action. This removes any basic Penalties given from zero gravity scenarios. Has a Full Move speed of 16 Meters. Has Magnetized Boots for improved movement and the capability of walking on metallic surfaces.

traits.name: Improved Motion Tracker
traits.description: An upgraded Motion Tracker that doubles the distance of the Radar. Includes a Thermal Sensor for Thermal Imaging Special Rule, giving a +20 Bonus to Opposed Tests involving an Opponent’s Camouflage.

traits.name: Nano Technology
traits.description: When the suit is damaged, the suit will automatically begin a repair process. The suit will heal 1 point of damage against it or the user, once per day. The suit can do this 10 times before needing recharged between missions.

traits.name: GEN I and II Variants
traits.description: Mjolnir armor have specialized variants that can be chosen from. These variants can augment Special Abilities, Characteristics, and even Skills, while some can come with Equipment and Attachments. There are some GEN III Variants that can be used alongside GEN II Armor, but you can’t take them until 2559 and later.

traits.name: Self-Destruct
traits.description: The Armor is able to Self-Destruct and can only be activated by another Character if the user inside is confirmed to be deceased. Anything within Blast (20) is instantly killed unless a Luck is burnt. Everything within Blast (40) takes 6D10 +15 Damage with a Pierce of 35.

traits.name: Spartan IV Attuning
traits.description: When used alongside a Spartan IV and their unique augmentation process, the Character is able to have the GEN II Mjolnir to give them either a +1 Mythic Strength or +1 Mythic Agility of their choosing. This can be changed between missions but takes 2 days to perform.

traits.name: Spartans Only
traits.description: This armor can only be worn by Spartans due to the demand it puts on the body. If the Character wearing this armor is not a Spartan, every physical Action they take will deal 8D10 Special Damage to all body locations.

spartan_abilities.name: Thruster Pack
spartan_abilities.description: The Mjolnir Generation II suits have a built-in Thrust package. Doubles the user’s Half Move for a single Half Action. This takes 4 Half Actions to recharge.

spartan_abilities.name: Ground Pound
spartan_abilities.description: Using the thrusters to force the Spartan downward, Ground Pound causes a Blast (4) of the Spartan’s Punch Melee Attack, giving the attack a Pierce of the Spartan’s total Strength Modifier and Mythic Strength.

spartan_abilities.name: Spartan Charge Thrust Package
spartan_abilities.description: Modifying the Thrusters, the Character may Double the damage made with Charge Attacks. This takes four Half Actions to recharge.

spartan_abilities.name: Hover Stabilization
spartan_abilities.description: The suit will allow the user to Hover in the air for 2 Half Actions, as long as the Character is not in a free fall. The Hover Stabilization must then charge for 1 Half Action before being used again.

spartan_abilities.name: Sprint
spartan_abilities.description: Using the Mjolnir suit’s Overclocking system, the user’s movement is increased, allowing a character to gain +2 Mythic Agility for two Rounds.
